notes.title: 2024/12/8 update patch
notes.notes:
This update patch adds a new cheating feature. In the game, open the attribute interface, and you will see a button named 'fraud.' Clicking it once will add 50 attribute points and 10,000 gold coins. If you want to just watch the game's storyline, you can use this feature. Once activated, you will be invincible in the game.
This feature can be used with both new and old save files.

notes.title: English language version update! Discounts are now available!
notes.notes:
Today, the game has undergone a major update. The main content of this major update is to add the English language and fix some bugs that may affect the gameplay. 

A 14-day promotion will begin today, offering a 20% discount. We hope this game will bring some joy to everyone!

notes.title: Due to a minor error, the English language update needs to be delayed.
notes.notes: Due to a minor error, some of the previously completed English language data has been lost. We sincerely apologize, but the update originally scheduled for October 17th will need to be postponed. However, the issue will be fixed as soon as possible, and the update is expected to occur on October 20th.

notes.title: English language update will be released on October 17, 2024.
notes.notes: An English language update will be released on October 17, 2024, and there will be a discount available. If you’re interested in this game, please add it to your wishlist!
